summary: Frontend-only re-test after hardcoding Google Maps API key in public/index.html. Verified LocationPicker map loads correctly in BOTH the merchant (/formerchants) and customer (/forcustomers) registration modals. No 'Oops!' / 'This page didn't load Google Maps correctly' error, no Google Maps JS API errors in console, map renders Delhi-region tiles (default center), clicking the map places a marker and enables the 'Confirm Location' button in both flows.

issues: Google Maps console deprecation warnings: google.maps.places.SearchBox (not available to new customers as of Mar 1, 2025) and google.maps.Marker (deprecated Feb 21, 2024). Non-blocking today but recommend migrating to PlaceAutocompleteElement and AdvancedMarkerElement.

action_items: (Low priority / future) Migrate LocationPicker from google.maps.places.SearchBox -> PlaceAutocompleteElement and google.maps.Marker -> AdvancedMarkerElement to avoid future breakage.

(Security) The Google Maps API key is now hardcoded in public/index.html and committed to the repo. Ensure the key is HTTP-referrer restricted in Google Cloud Console to the production domain(s) to prevent quota abuse.
critical_code_review_comments: Hardcoding an API key in public/index.html works but is not ideal — a build-time env var (%REACT_APP_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY%) with a documented .env.example would be safer. Since the key is public-by-design on the client, referrer restrictions in GCP are the real protection.
LocationPicker uses deprecated Maps JS APIs (SearchBox, Marker) — still working but flagged by Google.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Map loading fix confirmed working on both /formerchants and /forcustomers registration modals via the readonly location input. Confirm Location button enables after clicking the map. Razorpay and live registration submission were intentionally NOT tested per request.
